title: How Tibo built Tweet Hunter and Taplio to an 8-figure exit: ship weekly, partner with creators, SEO tools
summary: Tibo explains how he and his co-founder shipped about 10 products in four months, hit on Tweet Hunter, then used creator equity partnerships and free SEO mini tools to grow Taplio. He also covers building for yourself, an earn-out heavy acquisition, and the LinkedIn ban.

principles.text: Fail fast by shipping a new product every week and moving on if it brings no revenue within a few weeks.
principles.quote: we started shipping a new product every week and it was like if it doesn't work like if if it doesn't bring some Revenue in just a few weeks we just go to the next product
